title: WHO REACT systemic corticosteroids for critically ill COVID-19

reference.citation: WHO REACT Working Group. Association Between Administration of Systemic Corticosteroids and Mortality Among Critically Ill Patients With COVID-19: A Meta-analysis. JAMA. 2020;324(13):1330-1341.

topic: systemic corticosteroids compared with usual care or placebo for all-cause mortality in critically ill COVID-19 patients

aliases: Efficacy of dexamethasone treatment for patients with ARDS caused by COVID-19
expected_trials.notes: Included in JAMA Table 1 as DEXA-COVID 19; the indexed publication is the protocol/design paper, not a complete results article.

aliases: Effect of Dexamethasone on Days Alive and Ventilator-Free
Dexamethasone in Hospitalized Patients with COVID-19
Effect of Dexamethasone in Hospitalized Patients with COVID-19
expected_trials.notes: JAMA benchmark uses the critically ill/mechanically ventilated subgroup, not the full hospitalized RECOVERY trial.

aliases: Effect of Hydrocortisone on 21-Day Mortality or Respiratory Support
expected_trials.timepoint_notes: CAPE COVID reports a 21-day treatment-failure endpoint; using it in a 28-day mortality benchmark requires explicit protocol/user adjudication rather than silent pooling.

aliases: Hydrocortisone for COVID-19 and Severe Hypoxia
expected_trials.notes: Included trial in the prospective meta-analysis; limited separately indexed results at the benchmark date.

aliases: Effect of Hydrocortisone on Mortality and Organ Support
Methylprednisolone in severe acute respiratory infection
expected_trials.notes: Included in JAMA Table 1 as unpublished/randomized trial data.
